name: Kasha
steps: Rinse the toasted buckwheat groats quickly and drain. Bring measured water and half the salt to a boil.
Add buckwheat, cover and simmer gently for 15–18 minutes until tender and liquid is absorbed. Rest covered 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Meanwhile melt butter in a wide pan and brown chopped onion and sliced mushrooms for 8–10 minutes until their moisture evaporates.
Fold mushrooms into the buckwheat. Season with remaining salt and black pepper, scatter parsley and serve warm in four bowls.
tips: Use whole toasted groats, not buckwheat flour, for a fluffy kasha.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
